# Introduction

This document generates box plots of cytokine concentrations measured at each
treatment visit in patients with successful treatment outcome (n=33). Visits
are compared pairwise using the Wilcoxon test with FDR adjustment.

Figure 2B shows results for cytokines shortlisted by Random Forest with highest AUCs.
Figure S5B shows results for the rest of significantly changed cytokines following successful treatment.

# Load Packages

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readxl)
library(DataExplorer)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)       
```

# Define File Paths

```{r}
input_file  <- "Input/Cytokines_cleaned_log10_Predict-TB.xlsx"

output_fig2b_s5b  <- "Output/02. Figure_2B_S5B"

output_fig2b_s5b_mtb_ag  <- "Output/02. Figure_2B_S5B/Mtb_Ag"
output_fig2b_s5b_lps  <- "Output/02. Figure_2B_S5B/LPS"
output_fig2b_s5b_il1b  <- "Output/02. Figure_2B_S5B/IL1B"

dir.create(output_fig2b_s5b,  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(output_fig2b_s5b_null,  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(output_fig2b_s5b_mtb_ag,  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(output_fig2b_s5b_lps,  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(output_fig2b_s5b_il1b,  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Load data

```{r}
all_data <- read_excel(input_file, sheet = 1)

head(all_data)
dim(all_data)
```

# Filter to successful treatment outcome

```{r}
protein_data <- all_data %>%
  filter(Comments == "success") 
```

# Define cytokine columns

```{r}
cytokine_cols <- c(
  "BDNF", "CCL11", "Factor_VII", "ICAM_1",
  "IL_1_alpha", "IL_1_beta", "IL_10", "IL_12p40",
  "IL_12p70", "IL_18", "IL_1RA", "IL_3", "IL_4",
  "IL_6", "IL_7", "IL_8", "CCL2", "CCL3",
  "MMP_3", "TNF", "VEGF", "IFNG", "IL_2",
  "pan_IFNA", "IFNB"
)
```

# Box Plot Function

```{r}
plot_cytokine <- function(data,
                          cytokine_name,
                          condition_filter = NULL,
                          visit_comparisons = list(
                            c("0", "16"), c("0", "24"), c("0", "72"),
                            c("16", "24"), c("16", "72"), c("24", "72")
                          ),
                          save_path  = NULL,
                          plot_width  = 3.5,
                          plot_height = 5) {


  if (!is.null(condition_filter)) {
    data <- data %>% filter(Condition %in% condition_filter)
  }

  plot_data <- data %>%
    select(ID1, Visit, Condition, all_of(cytokine_name)) %>%
    mutate(Visit = as.factor(Visit))

  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Visit, y = .data[[cytokine_name]])) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 16, outlier.size = 1) +
    geom_jitter(position = position_jitter(width = 0.08), size = 1) +
    facet_grid(~ Condition) +
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons       = visit_comparisons,
      method            = "wilcox.test",
      p.adjust.method = "fdr",
      label             = "p.signif",
      hide.ns           = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(
      title = cytokine_name,
      x     = "Visit (Week)",
      y     = "Concentration (log10 pg/mL)"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.border     = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      strip.text.x     = element_text(size = 14),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey80", color = "black")
)

  print(p)

  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(
        save_path,
        paste0(cytokine_name, "_boxplot",".png")
      ),
      plot   = p,
      width  = plot_width,
      height = plot_height,
      units  = "in"
    )
  }

  invisible(p)
}
```

# Null condition

```{r}
for (cyt in cytokine_cols) {
  plot_cytokine(
    data             = protein_data,
    cytokine_name    = cyt,
    condition_filter = "Null",
    save_path        = "Output/02. Figure_2B_S5B/Null/"
  )
}
```

# Null-subtracted box plot function for other stimulation conditions

```{r}
# Use untransformed data here since stimulation condition requires subtraction by Null, then log10 transformation.
protein_data_new <- protein_data %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(cytokine_cols), ~ 10^.x))

plot_cytokine_subtracted <- function(data,
                                     cytokine_name,
                                     condition_name,
                                     visit_comparisons = list(
                                       c("0", "16"), c("0", "24"), c("0", "72"),
                                       c("16", "24"), c("16", "72"), c("24", "72")
                                     ),
                                     save_path   = NULL,
                                     plot_width  = 3.5,
                                     plot_height = 5) {

  reference <- data %>%
    filter(Condition == "Null") %>%
    select(ID1, Visit, Reference = all_of(cytokine_name))

  plot_data <- data %>%
    filter(Condition == condition_name) %>%
    select(ID1, Visit, Condition, all_of(cytokine_name)) %>%
    left_join(reference, by = c("ID1", "Visit")) %>%
    mutate(
      Subtracted       = pmax(.data[[cytokine_name]] - Reference, 0),
      log10_Subtracted = log10(1 + Subtracted),
      Visit            = as.factor(Visit)
    )

  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Visit, y = log10_Subtracted)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 16, outlier.size = 1) +
    geom_jitter(position = position_jitter(width = 0.08), size = 1) +
    facet_grid(~ Condition) +
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = visit_comparisons,
      method      = "wilcox.test",
      p.adjust.method = "fdr",
      label       = "p.signif",
      hide.ns     = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(
      title = cytokine_name,
      x     = "Visit (Week)",
      y     = "Log10 subtracted concentration (pg/mL)"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.border     = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      strip.text.x     = element_text(size = 14),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey80", color = "black")
)

  print(p)

  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(
        save_path,
        paste0(cytokine_name, "_", condition_name, "_subtracted_boxplot.png")
      ),
      plot   = p,
      width  = plot_width,
      height = plot_height,
      units  = "in"
    )
  }

  invisible(p)
}
```
